chat_decision_checkpoint.implementation_context: Gserver local G drive read-only inspection

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'MOUNT_G_CANDIDATES:\n'
findmnt -rn -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE | grep -Ei '(^/mnt/g[[:space:]]|/gdrive|/drive-g|gserver.*storage|/media/g)' | head -20 || true
printf 'G_STORAGE_PATH_CANDIDATES:\n'
for p in /mnt/g /mnt/G /media/g /media/G /home/gace/Project/Gserver/storage /home/gace/Project/Gserver/data /mnt/gserver; do if test -d "$p"; then printf '%s\n' "$p"; fi; done
printf 'STORAGE_CONFIG_REFS:\n'
rg -n -i -m 12 'g.drive|g_drive|/mnt/g|storage_root|media_root' /home/gace/Project/Gserver/repository/config /home/gace/Project/Gserver/repository/docs 2>/dev/null | head -30 | sed -E 's/(token|secret|password)([[:space:]]*[:=][[:space:]]*)[^[:space:]]+/\1\2[REDACTED]/g' || true
